title: Player detailed attributes loaded but never exposed by any MCP tool
evidence: soccer_mcp/queries.py:368 _player_to_dict(detail=True) builds an 'attributes' block, but search_players (queries.py:435) and team_players (queries.py:440) both call it with detail=False; no tool sets detail=True, so ratings (overall/potential) are returned but per-skill attributes are not. R8 'returning ratings' is satisfied; the 'attributes' clause is not surfaced.
suggestion: Add a detail flag or a get_player tool that returns the attributes block.

title: Six tools beyond the required queries
evidence: soccer_mcp/server.py registers match_stats, list_teams, list_competitions, champion, relegated, team_players in addition to the 11 spec queries.
suggestion: None — surfaced as beyond-spec capability, not a deduction.

title: requirements.txt lists only mcp>=1.0; pytest (needed for R12) is a comment
evidence: requirements.txt lists 'mcp>=1.0' as the sole active dependency; pytest is referenced only in a comment, so `pip install -r requirements.txt` does not install the test runner.
suggestion: Add pytest to a dev/test extra or a separate requirements-dev.txt.

title: Player.gkdiving parsed but never returned
evidence: soccer_mcp/data_loader.py:510 loads gkdiving into Player, but _player_to_dict (queries.py:354) never emits it.
suggestion: Either surface gkdiving in the attributes block or drop the field.

title: Sandbox meta reports tests_passed=0/tests_total=0 despite 44 passing
evidence: _sandbox_meta.json has tests_passed=0, tests_total=0 while _score_stdout.log shows 44 passing dots and coverage_pct=92.59; a scorer count-parse quirk, not a real test failure (test_coverage=0.92).
suggestion: Cross-run note only — trust coverage_pct/pass dots over the tests_passed field for this harness.
